resources.string: Live view from the rear camera
The camera lets us see the terminal screen and help you find the button you need. After you continue, Android will ask you to allow camera access.
Without the camera, KioskVision cannot see the terminal screen. Select Try again, and in the Android window choose to allow camera access.
Android will no longer ask for camera access. Select Open settings, open Permissions, then Camera, and allow access. Then return to KioskVision.
No rear camera was found on this device.
The camera is being used by another app. KioskVision will try again automatically.
The camera is disabled on this device by a setting or device policy.
The camera could not be started.
